requirements.objective: Capture interfaces, rails, constraints, board outline, and manufacturer choice before selecting parts.

parts.objective: Select exact parts and footprints with manufacturer provenance before electrical implementation.

electrical.objective: Validate reviewed atopile sources, generated KiCad candidate, interfaces, rails, connectivity, and exact part selections.

electrical_freeze.objective: Create a SHA-bound boundary that freezes reviewed atopile connectivity, references, net names, footprints and exact part identities before physical work.
required_evidence: passing electrical contract and candidate review receipts

physical.objective: Import the frozen KiCad interchange board into the selected physical backend, prove parity, place reviewed blocks, and preserve backend-specific manual work.

routing.objective: Create isolated, audited low-risk routing candidates with KRT as a GUI-independent routing engine.
required_evidence: reviewed routing rules when committing real copper
notes: In the four_layer template, In1.Cu and In2.Cu are reserved planes; KRT signal routing is limited to outer layers.

release.objective: Run EasyEDA DRC, independent KiCad DRC/connectivity validation, JLC DFM, copper review, package checks, and guarded manufacturing export.

prototype.objective: Record assembly inspection and measured bring-up results against the exact released board.
forbidden: claiming hardware validation from DRC alone
